headline.bm: Rusia menghentam jambatan dan grid kuasa Kyiv semalaman, membunuh lapan orang, manakala AS memperketat sekatan Iran dan Senat menolak resolusi kuasa perang Iran; kumpulan dikaitkan China mengeksploitasi kelemahan sifar-hari kritikal VMware vCenter (tampal segera); Anwar bertemu Xi di Shenzhen dan berkata Malaysia tidak akan mengeksport nadir bumi mentah.
headline.en: Russia pounded Kyiv's bridges and power grid overnight, killing eight, while the US tightens its Iran blockade and the Senate rejects an Iran war powers resolution; a China-linked group is exploiting a critical VMware vCenter zero-day (patch now); Anwar met Xi in Shenzhen and said Malaysia will not export raw rare earths.

summary.bm: Selepas pertemuan dua hala 20 minit dengan Xi pada 20 Nov, Anwar berkata perbincangan merangkumi projek bekalan air Sungai Perak ke Pulau Pinang, AI untuk penguatkuasaan sempadan, kerjasama TVET dan peningkatan eksport ke China. Beliau berkata Malaysia tidak akan mengeksport nadir bumi mentah, peraturan yang sama untuk semua negara, dan Xi akan menghantar pegawai kanan ke pelancaran ECRL pada Disember. Anwar turut berkata beliau tidak kesal menyokong Xi dan memuji peranan Xi menemukan Trump dan Putin.
summary.en: After a 20-minute bilateral with Xi on 20 Nov, Anwar said talks covered the Sungai Perak water project to Penang, AI for border enforcement, TVET cooperation and higher exports to China. He said Malaysia will not export raw rare earths, a rule applied to all countries, and Xi will send a senior official to the ECRL launch in December. Anwar also said he has no regrets backing Xi and credited him with bringing Trump and Putin together.

title.bm: Anwar bertemu Xi di Shenzhen: nadir bumi diproses di Malaysia, pegawai kanan China hadir pelancaran ECRL
title.en: Anwar meets Xi in Shenzhen: rare earths to be processed in Malaysia, ECRL launch to get senior Chinese delegate

why.bm: Menetapkan pendirian mengenai nadir bumi dan mendapat sokongan China untuk ECRL serta bekalan air Pulau Pinang.
why.en: Sets the line on rare earths and secures China's backing for ECRL and the Penang water supply.

summary.bm: Laporan New York Times mendakwa cip Nvidia di pusat data YTL Johor digunakan untuk Alibaba, mengelak sekatan eksport AS. Timbalan Menteri MITI Sim Tze Tzin berkata Malaysia akan membuat semakan sendiri atas kemungkinan eksport semula cip.
summary.en: A New York Times report says Nvidia chips at YTL's Johor data centre were used for Alibaba, bypassing US export curbs. MITI Deputy Minister Sim Tze Tzin said Malaysia will run its own check on possible chip re-exports.

title.bm: NYT: Cip Nvidia di pusat data YTL Johor digunakan untuk Alibaba China; MITI akan siasat
title.en: NYT: Nvidia chips at YTL's Johor data centre run for China's Alibaba; MITI to probe

why.bm: Boleh mengundang pemerhatian AS terhadap sektor pusat data dan cip Malaysia.
why.en: Could bring US scrutiny on Malaysia's data-centre and chip sector.

summary.bm: Timbalan Perdana Menteri Zahid berkata RUU MARA akan dibentangkan sebelum persidangan Parlimen semasa berakhir.
summary.en: Deputy Prime Minister Zahid said the MARA Bill will be tabled before the current Parliament sitting ends.

title.bm: Zahid: RUU MARA dibawa ke Dewan Rakyat sebelum persidangan tahun ini berakhir
title.en: Zahid: MARA Bill to reach Dewan Rakyat before this sitting ends

why.bm: Ia menyentuh tadbir urus agensi pendidikan dan perniagaan Bumiputera itu.
why.en: It affects the Bumiputera education and business agency's governance.

summary.bm: Selepas mengadap Tuanku Muhriz di Istana Hinggap pada 20 Nov, Ismail berkata Baginda bertitah beliau kekal sebagai Menteri Besar. Beliau menegaskan tidak menyerahkan atau bersetuju dengan surat peletakan jawatan bertarikh 16 Nov dan diminta terus berkhidmat demi kesinambungan pentadbiran negeri.
summary.en: After an audience with Tuanku Muhriz at Istana Hinggap on 20 Nov, Ismail said the Ruler decreed he stays on as MB. He says he neither submitted nor consented to the 16 Nov resignation letter, and was told to keep serving for continuity of state administration.

title.bm: Yang di-Pertuan Besar titahkan Ismail Lasim kekal sebagai Menteri Besar Negeri Sembilan
title.en: Negeri Sembilan Ruler decrees Ismail Lasim stays as Menteri Besar

why.bm: Menamatkan kebimbangan beberapa hari tentang kepimpinan negeri, walaupun imbangan BN–PH dan desakan MB baharu sebelum ini masih sensitif.
why.en: Ends days of uncertainty over who leads the state, though the BN–PH balance and the earlier push for a new MB remain politically sensitive.

summary.bm: Ringgit dibuka pada 4.1105 berbanding dolar AS berbanding 4.1100 pada penutup Khamis, dengan DXY pada 103.944. Seorang ekonomi berkata hujah untuk kenaikan 50 mata asas Fed pada Disember semakin kukuh.
summary.en: The ringgit opened at 4.1105 per US dollar against 4.1100 at Thursday's close, with the DXY at 103.944. An economist said the case for a 50bp Fed hike in December is building.

title.bm: Ringgit stabil sekitar RM4.11 ketika kebimbangan kenaikan kadar Fed berterusan
title.en: Ringgit steady near RM4.11 as Fed hike fears persist

why.bm: Dolar yang kukuh menjejaskan kos import dan tinjauan kadar dasar Bank Negara.
why.en: A firm dollar affects import costs and the outlook for Bank Negara's policy rate.

summary.bm: Berita Harian melaporkan kadar inflasi keseluruhan meningkat sedikit kepada 1.9 peratus bulan lalu. Angka September ialah 1.8 peratus, dengan kos makan di luar dan pengangkutan antara yang naik.
summary.en: Berita Harian reports the headline inflation rate edged up to 1.9% last month. September's figure was 1.8%, with dining out and transport costs among the items rising.

title.bm: Kadar inflasi Malaysia meningkat kepada 1.9 peratus pada Oktober berbanding 1.8 peratus pada September
title.en: Malaysia's inflation rises to 1.9% in October from 1.8% in September

why.bm: Tekanan harga masih sederhana tetapi beransur naik bersama kos bahan api dan pengeluar yang lebih tinggi.
why.en: Price pressures remain mild but are creeping up with higher fuel and producer costs.

summary.bm: Anwar berkata dokumen sulit Lembaga Pengampunan boleh dinyahklasifikasi melalui prosiding mahkamah. Penggubal undang-undang BN pula menggesa audit dalaman dan siasatan polis atas kebocoran kertas pengampunan Najib.
summary.en: Anwar said confidential Pardons Board papers can be declassified through court proceedings. BN lawmakers separately called for an internal audit and a police probe over the leaked Najib pardon papers.

title.bm: Anwar: Pemeriksaan mahkamah boleh mengatasi kerahsiaan dokumen Lembaga Pengampunan
title.en: Anwar: court scrutiny can override secrecy of Pardons Board documents

why.bm: Kebocoran ini terus menguji ketelusan kerajaan dan perpaduan gabungan.
why.en: The leak is a continuing test of government transparency and coalition unity.

summary.bm: Ekonomi Malaysia berkembang 5.5% pada suku ketiga, perlahan berbanding 6.0% setahun lalu tetapi melebihi anggaran awal 5.3%, dengan laporan menyebut pelaburan, eksport, permintaan berkaitan AI dan pelancongan.
summary.en: Malaysia's economy expanded 5.5% in the third quarter, eased from 6.0% a year earlier but above the 5.3% advance estimate, with reports citing investment, exports, AI-related demand and tourism.

title.bm: KDNK suku ketiga Malaysia berkembang 5.5%, melepasi anggaran awal 5.3%, didorong pelaburan dan eksport
title.en: Malaysia's Q3 GDP grows 5.5%, beating the 5.3% advance estimate, on investment and exports

why.bm: Pertumbuhan stabil menyokong pekerjaan dan ringgit, namun risiko luar daripada perang Iran dan harga minyak kekal.
why.en: Steady growth supports jobs and the ringgit, though external risks from the Iran war and oil remain.

summary.bm: Anwar menyertai gesaan siasatan menyeluruh dan telus terhadap kematian pelajar sekolah berasrama di Perak. Butiran siasatan belum didedahkan. Pelajar Tingkatan Tiga itu dikebumikan di Kuala Pilah pada 20 Nov dan bapanya meminta siasatan telus.
summary.en: Anwar joined calls for a thorough and transparent probe into the death of a boarding school student in Perak. Details of the investigation have yet to be released. The Form Three student was buried in Kuala Pilah on 20 Nov and his father asked for a transparent probe.

title.bm: Anwar mahu siasatan menyeluruh selepas pelajar sekolah berasrama meninggal di Perak
title.en: Anwar wants thorough probe after boarding school student dies in Perak

why.bm: Menimbulkan persoalan keselamatan dan kebajikan di sekolah berasrama.
why.en: Raises questions on safety and welfare in residential schools.

summary.bm: Pemeriksaan bagasi rutin menemui dadah dan lima pegawai TUDM ditahan. Polis berkata dadah diterbangkan ke Sabah dengan pesawat tentera, mungkin untuk pasaran Indonesia dan Filipina.
summary.en: A routine luggage check found drugs and five RMAF officers were held. Police say the drugs were flown to Sabah on military aircraft, likely for Indonesian and Philippine markets.

title.bm: Dadah ditemui dalam bagasi di pangkalan udara Subang; lima pegawai TUDM ditahan
title.en: Drugs found in luggage at Subang air base; five RMAF officers held

why.bm: Kes integriti serius; Anwar sebelum ini menyuarakan kebimbangan dakwaan pengedaran dadah TUDM.
why.en: A serious integrity case; Anwar earlier raised alarm over alleged air force trafficking.

summary.bm: The Black Parade 2026 dibuka di Stadium Nasional TM pada 19 Nov dan berlangsung lagi pada 20 Nov, dengan dianggarkan 120,000 peminat sepanjang dua malam. Tarikh ditunda daripada April dan Mei, dan peminat menganjurkan projek cahaya dengan 20,000 potongan kertas merah.
summary.en: The Black Parade 2026 opened at TM National Stadium on 19 Nov and continues on 20 Nov, with an estimated 120,000 fans over both nights. Dates were postponed from April and May, and fans organised a light-up project with 20,000 red cutouts.

title.bm: My Chemical Romance kembali ke Bukit Jalil selepas hampir 19 tahun
title.en: My Chemical Romance returns to Bukit Jalil after nearly 19 years

why.bm: Jangkakan trafik sesak dan orang ramai sekitar Bukit Jalil malam ini.
why.en: Expect heavy traffic and crowds around Bukit Jalil tonight.

summary.bm: Sungai itu melepasi ambang amaran 7.0m. Penduduk diminta berwaspada.
summary.en: The river passed the 7.0m alert threshold. Residents are told to stay alert.

title.bm: Sungai Golok di Rantau Panjang cecah 7.18m, melepasi paras amaran
title.en: Sungai Golok at Rantau Panjang hits 7.18m, above alert level

why.bm: Sediakan langkah berjaga-jaga jika tinggal berdekatan.
why.en: Prepare to move valuables if you live nearby.

summary.bm: Sistem Amaran Awal menggunakan Siaran Sel tanpa memerlukan aplikasi, pendaftaran atau langganan, dan dilancarkan secara berperingkat. Acara 19 Nov ialah ujian teknikal dalaman di pejabat MCMC Cyberjaya, dengan ujian lebih besar akan menyusul. Fahmi berkata ujian pada 23 Nov berhampiran Parlimen dan 29 Nov di seluruh negara.
summary.en: The Early Warning System uses Cell Broadcast, needing no app, registration or subscription, and is rolling out in stages. The 19 Nov event was an internal technical test at MCMC's Cyberjaya office, with larger tests to follow. Fahmi says tests are on 23 Nov near Parliament and 29 Nov nationwide.

title.bm: MCMC: kemas kini telefon untuk menerima amaran kecemasan baharu Malaysia
title.en: MCMC: update your phones to receive Malaysia's new emergency alerts

why.bm: Sokongan dijangka: iPhone 11 ke atas dengan iOS 27.2+, Android 12+, Huawei EMUI 16+ (tertakluk pengesahan akhir); kemas kini telefon anda.
why.en: Expected support: iPhone 11 and newer on iOS 27.2+, Android 12+, Huawei EMUI 16+ (subject to final confirmation); update your phone.

summary.bm: Chow Kon Yeow mempertahankan perjanjian 40 tahun itu; Lim Guan Eng mempersoalkan bayaran RM210j setahun bagi air yang belum dibekalkan.
summary.en: Chow Kon Yeow defended the 40-year deal; Lim Guan Eng asked why RM210m a year is paid for water not yet delivered.

title.bm: Perjanjian air Pulau Pinang-Perak RM8.4b: RM210j setahun dipertikai
title.en: Penang-Perak RM8.4b water deal: RM210m a year draws scrutiny

why.bm: Kos bekalan air boleh menjejaskan tarif akan datang.
why.en: Water supply costs can affect future tariffs.

summary.bm: Harimau itu membunuh seorang lelaki berhampiran Bawong, Perak, kemudian menyerang pegawai Perhilitan dan ditembak mati.
summary.en: The tiger fatally attacked a man near Bawong, Perak, then attacked Perhilitan personnel and was shot dead.

title.bm: Harimau yang membunuh lelaki Orang Asli di Sungai Siput ditembak mati
title.en: Tiger that killed Orang Asli man in Sungai Siput shot dead

why.bm: Penduduk berhampiran hutan perlu berhati-hati.
why.en: Villagers near forest edges should stay cautious.

summary.bm: Dalang rompakan terbunuh dalam tembak-menembak; empat anggota kumpulan masih bebas.
summary.en: The robbery mastermind was killed in the shootout; four gang members are still at large.

title.bm: Polis buru empat anggota kumpulan selepas tembak-menembak Ipoh bunuh dalang rompakan
title.en: Police hunt four gang members after Ipoh shootout kills robbery mastermind

why.bm: Polis meminta maklumat orang ramai.
why.en: Police ask for public information.

summary.bm: Kajian kerajaan meliputi lelaki Malaysia berumur 13 tahun ke atas.
summary.en: The government study covers Malaysian men aged 13 and above.

title.bm: Kajian Lelaki Kebangsaan 8,236 lelaki bermula, hingga 31 Dis
title.en: National Gentleman Study of 8,236 men starts, runs to 31 Dec

why.bm: Lelaki terpilih mungkin dihubungi.
why.en: Selected men may be contacted.

summary.bm: Bilik darjah itu memanfaatkan 3,820 murid.
summary.en: The classrooms will benefit 3,820 pupils.

title.bm: KL sedia 86 bilik darjah untuk kanak-kanak 6 tahun masuk Tahun Satu 2027
title.en: KL prepares 86 classrooms for six-year-olds entering Year One in 2027

why.bm: Ibu bapa kanak-kanak enam tahun 2027 perlu ambil maklum.
why.en: Parents of 2027 six-year-olds should note the intake.

summary.bm: Sepuluh lori dikesan di Rimba Terjun.
summary.en: Ten lorries were detected at Rimba Terjun.

title.bm: Johor henti tebus guna Pontian kerana disyaki longgokan sisa pembinaan asing
title.en: Johor halts Pontian reclamation over suspected foreign construction waste dumping

why.bm: Isu penguatkuasaan alam sekitar.
why.en: Environmental enforcement concern.

summary.bm: Amaran banjir meliputi Sepang, Kuala Langat dan Gombak sehingga Sabtu. Di Bentong, Pahang, hujan lebat mencetuskan banjir kilat pada malam Rabu.
summary.en: Flood warnings cover Sepang, Kuala Langat and Gombak through Saturday. Separately, heavy rain triggered flash floods in Bentong, Pahang, on Tuesday night.

title.bm: Sepang, Kuala Langat dan Gombak diramal banjir hingga Sabtu
title.en: Sepang, Kuala Langat and Gombak forecast to flood until Saturday

why.bm: Elak jalan rendah dan semak amaran banjir rasmi sebelum bergerak.
why.en: Avoid low-lying roads and check official flood alerts before travelling.

summary.bm: Bas dari Keningau ke Labuan membawa 20 penumpang hilang kawalan ketika menuruni bukit di Jalan Bukit Kimanis-Keningau kira-kira 1.30 tengah hari Rabu. Lima penumpang warga emas berusia 60 hingga 71 tahun parah dan 16 lagi cedera ringan.
summary.en: A bus from Keningau to Labuan carrying 20 passengers lost control going downhill on Jalan Bukit Kimanis-Keningau around 1.30pm on Wednesday. Five older passengers aged 60-71 were seriously injured and 16 others had minor injuries.

title.bm: Bas persiaran terbabas di Papar, Sabah: lima warga emas parah, 16 lagi cedera
title.en: Tour bus veers off road in Papar, Sabah: five seniors seriously hurt, 16 injured

why.bm: Peringatan supaya brek dan rehat pemandu diperiksa di jalan bukit pedalaman.
why.en: A reminder to check brakes and driver rest on hilly interior roads.

summary.bm: Jawatankuasa Kira-kira Wang Negara (PAC) menggesa kerajaan menamatkan monopoli konsesi bekalan kenderaan. Gesaan itu dilaporkan Malay Mail pada 18 Nov.
summary.en: The Public Accounts Committee has called on the government to end the monopoly on vehicle supply concessions. The call was reported by Malay Mail on 18 Nov.

title.bm: PAC gesa kerajaan putuskan monopoli konsesi bekalan kenderaan
title.en: PAC urges govt to break monopoly on vehicle supply concessions

why.bm: Monopoli konsesi boleh menjejaskan kos dan persaingan untuk pengguna jalan raya dan wang awam.
why.en: Concession monopolies can affect costs and competition for road users and the public purse.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan BNM berkata bank meningkatkan perbelanjaan keselamatan siber selepas serangan baru-baru ini.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports BNM says banks are raising cybersecurity spending after recent attacks.

title.bm: Bank Malaysia tingkat pelaburan keselamatan siber selepas serangan baru-baru ini, kata BNM
title.en: Malaysian banks step up cybersecurity investment after recent attacks, says BNM

why.bm: Berkaitan keselamatan akaun bank anda.
why.en: Relevant to the safety of your bank accounts.

summary.bm: Dua orang maut dan seorang cedera apabila sebuah Honda Civic bertembung dengan lori ayam di Lebuhraya Gerik-Jeli. Butiran dilaporkan Malay Mail pada 18 Nov.
summary.en: Two people died and one was injured when a Honda Civic collided with a poultry truck on the Gerik-Jeli Highway. Details were reported by Malay Mail on 18 Nov.

title.bm: Dua maut selepas Honda Civic bertembung lori ayam di Lebuhraya Gerik-Jeli
title.en: Two dead after Honda Civic crashes with poultry truck on Gerik-Jeli Highway

why.bm: Peringatan agar lebih berhati-hati di lebuh raya jarak jauh.
why.en: A reminder to take care on long highway stretches.

summary.bm: SPRM mengemukakan tujuh syor kepada JPN dan KKM.
summary.en: MACC submitted seven recommendations to JPN and the Health Ministry.

title.bm: SPRM kemuka tujuh syor tingkat ketelusan pendaftaran kelahiran
title.en: MACC makes seven recommendations to improve birth registration transparency

why.bm: Bertujuan memperketat proses identiti utama.
why.en: Aims to tighten a key identity process.

summary.bm: Kementerian Dalam Negeri berkata kerugian akibat penipuan dalam talian berjumlah RM6.95 bilion sejak 2023. Polis meneruskan tindakan terhadap sindiket penipuan.
summary.en: The Home Ministry said losses to online scams total RM6.95 billion since 2023. Police continue crackdowns on scam syndicates.

title.bm: Rakyat Malaysia rugi RM6.95 bilion akibat penipuan dalam talian sejak 2023, kata KDN
title.en: Malaysians lost RM6.95b to online scams since 2023, Home Ministry says

why.bm: Sahkan panggilan dan pautan tidak dikenali; lapor melalui NSRC 997.
why.en: Verify unknown calls and links; report via NSRC 997.

summary.bm: Bernama melaporkan Malaysia meraih kemenangan 2-1 ke atas Yemen dalam perlawanan antarabangsa Tier 1 pada 17 Nov.
summary.en: Bernama reports Malaysia clinched a 2-1 win over Yemen in an international Tier 1 match on 17 Nov.

title.bm: Malaysia menewaskan Yemen 2-1 dalam perlawanan antarabangsa Tier 1
title.en: Malaysia beat Yemen 2-1 in an international Tier 1 match

why.bm: Keputusan positif buat peminat sukan negara.
why.en: A positive result for national sport fans.

summary.bm: The Star melaporkan lebih separuh peletakan jawatan doktor Kementerian Kesihatan disebabkan tarikan sektor swasta.
summary.en: The Star reports more than half of Health Ministry doctor resignations are due to the pull of the private sector.

title.bm: Tarikan sektor swasta punca lebih separuh peletakan jawatan doktor KKM
title.en: Private sector lure drives over half of Health Ministry doctor resignations

why.bm: Kekurangan kakitangan boleh menjejaskan masa menunggu di hospital awam.
why.en: Staffing strain may affect public hospital waiting times.

summary.bm: Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil memaklumkan Dewan Rakyat platform mempunyai sehingga akhir 2026 untuk menyediakan tindakan automatik terhadap kandungan berbahaya di bawah kod Akta Keselamatan Dalam Talian 2025, dengan denda RM1 juta hingga RM10 juta setiap kesalahan. Mesyuarat tiga negara dijangka pada pertengahan Disember.
summary.en: Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil told Parliament platforms have until end-2026 to set up automatic action on harmful content under the Online Safety Act 2025 code, with fines of RM1 million to RM10 million per offence. A three-country meeting is expected in mid-December.

title.bm: Malaysia, Singapura dan Indonesia bertemu Disember bincang tindakan terhadap platform media sosial degil
title.en: Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia to meet in December on defiant social media platforms

why.bm: Platform yang mengabaikan kandungan berbahaya seperti penipuan boleh berdepan denda berat.
why.en: Platforms that ignore harmful content such as scams may face heavy fines.

summary.bm: Kementerian memperuntukkan lebih RM13 bilion untuk menangani sekolah daif di seluruh negara hingga 2027.
summary.en: The ministry has allocated over RM13 billion to tackle dilapidated schools nationwide through 2027.

title.bm: KPM peruntuk lebih RM13b bagi sekolah daif hingga 2027
title.en: Education Ministry allocates over RM13b for dilapidated schools through 2027

why.bm: Bangunan sekolah lebih selamat untuk murid di seluruh negara.
why.en: Safer school buildings for pupils nationwide.

summary.bm: Tinjauan Tenaga Dunia 2026 IEA menyatakan perang menghilangkan kira-kira 2.8 bilion tong minyak dan 60 bcm gas, dan permintaan minyak global jatuh 2.7 juta tong sehari pada 2026 kepada 102.3 juta. Brent ditutup hampir $93.6 dan WTI hampir $84.5 pada 19 Nov.
summary.en: The IEA's World Energy Outlook 2026 says the war removed about 2.8 billion barrels of oil and 60 bcm of gas, and global oil demand falls 2.7 mb/d in 2026 to 102.3 mb/d. Brent closed 19 Nov near $93.6 and WTI near $84.5.

title.bm: IEA: Perang Iran hilangkan 2.8 bilion tong minyak; permintaan minyak global jatuh pertama sejak 2020
title.en: IEA: Iran war cost 2.8bn barrels of oil; global oil demand set for first drop since 2020

why.bm: Mempengaruhi jangkaan minyak, subsidi bahan api dan ringgit Malaysia.
why.en: Shapes oil, fuel-subsidy and ringgit expectations for Malaysia.

summary.bm: Brent sekitar $92 setong, WTI sekitar $83 selepas jatuh 3.2% ke paras terendah sejak 26 Ogos. Aliran minyak mentah Hormuz hampir pulih ke paras sebelum perang dan stok AS naik 3.4 juta tong, manakala jangkaan kenaikan kadar Fed menyokong dolar.
summary.en: Brent was about $92 a barrel, WTI about $83 after a 3.2% drop that took it to its lowest since 26 August. Hormuz crude flows are back near pre-war levels and US crude stocks rose 3.4 million barrels, while Fed hike expectations support the dollar.

title.bm: Minyak stabil sekitar $92 apabila serangan perkapalan Asia Barat mengimbangi jangkaan lebihan bekalan
title.en: Oil steady near $92 as Middle East shipping attacks offset supply-surplus outlook

why.bm: Minyak lebih murah meredakan tekanan kos bahan api dan subsidi, tetapi serangan kapal tangki menjadikan harga tidak menentu.
why.en: Lower oil eases pressure on fuel and subsidy costs, but tanker attacks keep prices volatile.

summary.bm: Dolar mencecah puncak 19 bulan baharu kerana jangkaan pengetatan Fed, dan saham jatuh selepas sekatan cip AI baharu AS terhadap China. Kuprum LME tiga bulan turun 0.4% kepada $13,210 satu tan, terendah lebih empat bulan.
summary.en: The dollar hit a fresh 19-month peak on bets of Fed tightening, and stocks fell after new US AI-chip curbs on China. Three-month LME copper fell 0.4% to $13,210 a tonne, its lowest in over four months.

title.bm: Dolar cecah paras tertinggi 19 bulan atas jangkaan Fed ketatkan dasar; kuprum terendah empat bulan
title.en: Dollar hits fresh 19-month high on Fed tightening bets; copper at four-month low

why.bm: Dolar kukuh menekan ringgit dan kos import.
why.en: A strong dollar pressures the ringgit and import costs.

summary.bm: Hasil Perbendaharaan 10 tahun naik ke sekitar 5.15% (naik kira-kira 30 mata asas seminggu) dan indeks dolar ke 103.41, tertinggi sejak April 2025. Niaga hadapan sepenuhnya menjangka kenaikan kadar pada FOMC 8-9 Dis.
summary.en: The 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 5.15% (up roughly 30bp on the week) and the dollar index to 103.41, its highest since April 2025. Futures fully price a rate hike at the 8-9 Dec FOMC.

title.bm: Dolar hampir paras tertinggi 19 bulan apabila pedagang meramal kenaikan kadar Fed; hasil 10 tahun 5.14%
title.en: Dollar near 19-month high as traders price possible Fed hike; 10-year yield at 5.14%

why.bm: Dolar lebih kukuh dan hasil lebih tinggi menekan ringgit dan Bursa serta menaikkan kos import.
why.en: A stronger dollar and higher yields weigh on the ringgit and Bursa and raise import costs.

summary.bm: Pertumbuhan tahunan 1.9%. Timbalan Gabenor BoE Lombardelli berkata kejutan tenaga lebih lama daripada dijangka, menguatkan hujah kenaikan kadar lagi; sidang kemuncak UK-EU dijadual 20 Nov.
summary.en: Annual growth was 1.9%. BoE Deputy Governor Lombardelli said the energy shock has lasted longer than expected, strengthening the case for more hikes; a UK-EU summit is set for 20 Nov.

title.bm: KDNK UK suku ketiga naik 0.7%, terkukuh dalam lebih dua tahun, BoE beri amaran kejutan tenaga berpanjangan
title.en: UK Q3 GDP grows 0.7%, strongest in over two years, as BoE warns energy shock lasts longer

why.bm: Kadar tinggi lebih lama di ekonomi utama mengekalkan pembiayaan global ketat.
why.en: Higher-for-longer rates in major economies keep global financing tight.

summary.bm: Beijing mengecam penggunaan dakwaan "pengintipan" Nvidia oleh AS untuk mempertahankan sekatan teknologi, merumitkan pertemuan Xi-Trump minggu depan. Gencatan setahun itu tamat pada Januari. Senator Demokrat meminta rekod eksport Nvidia dipelihara.
summary.en: Beijing denounced US use of Nvidia "spying" claims to defend tech curbs, complicating next week's Xi-Trump meeting. The year-long truce expires in January. Democratic senators asked the administration to preserve Nvidia export records.

title.bm: Pertikaian Nvidia menguji gencatan dagang AS-China menjelang kunjungan Trump ke Xi minggu depan
title.en: Nvidia row tests US-China trade truce as Xi set to welcome Trump next week

why.bm: Kegagalan rundingan boleh menjejaskan rantaian bekalan cip dan sektor semikonduktor Malaysia yang bergantung pada eksport.
why.en: A breakdown would hit chip supply chains and Malaysia's export-driven semiconductor sector.

summary.bm: Jadual WHO (data DRC hingga 17 Nov) mencatat 11,613 kes disahkan dan 5,678 kematian di DRC, 9 kes disahkan di Kenya serta kes import di tempat lain; jumlah keseluruhan 11,644 kes disahkan dan 5,682 kematian. Tiada vaksin atau rawatan khusus.
summary.en: WHO's table (DRC data to 17 Nov) lists 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths in DRC, with 9 confirmed in Kenya and imported cases elsewhere; the total is 11,644 confirmed cases and 5,682 deaths. There is no vaccine or specific treatment.

title.bm: Ebola (Bundibugyo): Jumlah WHO capai 11,644 kes disahkan dan 5,682 kematian
title.en: Ebola (Bundibugyo): WHO tally reaches 11,644 confirmed cases and 5,682 deaths

why.bm: WHO tidak menggalakkan larangan perjalanan; elakkan bersentuhan dengan pesakit dan dapatkan rawatan jika demam selepas pulang dari kawasan terjejas.
why.en: WHO advises against travel bans; avoid contact with the sick and seek care for fever after travel to affected areas.

summary.bm: Laporan yang memetik Wall Street Journal menyatakan AS hilang status penghapusan campak selepas penularan berterusan; ABC melaporkan kes seluruh negara melebihi 5,400 dengan 10 kematian. CDC merekodkan 5,412 kes disahkan setakat 13 Nov, naik 230 seminggu.
summary.en: Reports citing the Wall Street Journal say the US lost its measles elimination status after continued spread; ABC reports nationwide cases above 5,400 with 10 deaths. The CDC counted 5,412 confirmed cases by 13 Nov, up 230 in a week.

title.bm: AS dilaporkan hilang status penghapusan campak apabila kes melebihi 5,400
title.en: US reported to lose measles elimination status as cases top 5,400

why.bm: Semak vaksin MMR anak sebelum melancong ke AS.
why.en: Check children's MMR vaccination before travelling to the US.

summary.bm: Gardenia Malaysia Timur menjelaskan ia entiti berasingan daripada Gardenia KL selepas aduan membabitkan Original Classic White Bread dan Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. KKM menunggu keputusan makmal dan akan memeriksa kilang KL di bawah Akta Makanan 1983; nombor kelompok belum lengkap.
summary.en: Gardenia East Malaysia says it is separate from Gardenia KL after complaints involving Original Classic White Bread and Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. The Health Ministry awaits lab results and will inspect the KL factory under the Food Act 1983; batch numbers are incomplete.

title.bm: Malaysia: KKM siasat dakwaan sakit selepas makan produk Gardenia
title.en: Malaysia: KKM probes illness claims linked to Gardenia bread and snacks

why.bm: Nota keselamatan: simpan bungkusan dan lapor gejala kepada KKM; tiada penarikan balik diumumkan.
why.en: Safety note: keep the packaging and report symptoms to KKM; no recall announced.

summary.bm: Dua kes disahkan klade 1 dan dua lagi disyaki menunggu analisis; tiga pesakit berkata mereka tidak keluar dari daerah itu setahun lalu. Klade 1 mempunyai kadar kematian dilaporkan 1% hingga 10%, berbanding 1% hingga 4% bagi klade 2.
summary.en: Two cases are confirmed clade 1 and two are suspected pending analysis; three patients say they did not leave the county in the past year. Clade 1 has a reported fatality rate of 1% to 10%, versus 1% to 4% for clade 2.

title.bm: California siasat empat kes mpox klade 1 di Stanislaus County, tiga tanpa sejarah perjalanan
title.en: California investigates four clade 1 mpox cases in Stanislaus County, three with no travel

why.bm: Penularan tempatan menunjukkan jangkitan tidak dikesan; elak sentuhan rapat dengan orang berruam dan dapatkan rawatan awal jika bergejala.
why.en: Local spread suggests undetected transmission; avoid close contact with anyone with a rash and seek care early if symptoms appear.

summary.bm: ICJ memutuskan pada 19 Nov bahawa Myanmar melakukan genosid terhadap Rohingya dalam tindakan keras Rakhine 2017, dengan undian 9-6 daripada 15 hakim. Pada 20 Nov jurucakap presiden menyifatkan keputusan itu 'tidak adil'.
summary.en: The ICJ ruled on 19 Nov that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in its 2017 Rakhine crackdown, by a 9-6 vote of 15 judges. On 20 Nov the presidential spokeswoman called the ruling 'not fair'.

title.bm: Myanmar tolak keputusan ICJ genosid sebagai 'tidak adil'
title.en: Myanmar rejects ICJ genocide ruling as 'not fair'

why.bm: Malaysia menempatkan ramai pelarian Rohingya dan ASEAN berdepan tekanan berhubung Myanmar.
why.en: Malaysia hosts a large Rohingya refugee population and ASEAN faces pressure over Myanmar.

summary.bm: Peluru berpandu dan dron Rusia membunuh lapan orang (enam di Kyiv) dan mencederakan 28, kata PM Ukraine. Datuk Bandar Kyiv berkata tiga jambatan rosak dan loji nuklear mengurangkan output, menyebabkan gangguan bekalan di Kyiv dan 10 wilayah.
summary.en: Russian missiles and drones killed eight people (six in Kyiv) and wounded 28, Ukraine's PM said. Kyiv's mayor said three bridges were damaged and nuclear plants cut output, causing outages in Kyiv and 10 regions.

title.bm: Rusia hentam jambatan Kyiv dalam serangan semalaman; lapan terbunuh
title.en: Russia hits Kyiv bridges in overnight barrage; eight killed

why.bm: Peningkatan ketegangan susulan ikrar Putin untuk tindak balas 'menyakitkan' atas Jambatan Kerch dan menambah risiko tenaga Eropah.
why.en: Escalation follows Putin's pledge of a 'painful' response over the Kerch Bridge and deepens energy risk for Europe.

summary.bm: CENTCOM berkata pada 18 Nov kapal yang menerima kargo daripada kapal tersekat boleh dihentikan, dinaiki atau dirampas. Reuters memetik TankerTrackers.com melaporkan sebuah kapal memuat minyak mentah Iran secara pemindahan antara kapal di Teluk, tidak disahkan Iran.
summary.en: CENTCOM said on 18 Nov that ships receiving cargo from blockaded vessels may be stopped, boarded or seized. Reuters, citing TankerTrackers.com, reported a vessel loading Iranian crude by ship-to-ship transfer in the Gulf, unconfirmed by Iran.

title.bm: AS beri amaran pemindahan minyak Iran antara kapal mungkin dianggap mengelak sekatan
title.en: US warns ship-to-ship transfers of Iranian oil may be treated as blockade evasion

why.bm: Sekatan lebih ketat mengekalkan harga minyak dan risiko perkapalan tinggi, memberi kesan kepada kos bahan api dan kargo Malaysia.
why.en: Tighter blockade keeps oil prices and shipping risk elevated, feeding into Malaysian fuel and freight costs.

summary.bm: Resolusi tidak mengikat itu gagal pada 19 Nov, dengan Murkowski dan Rand Paul daripada Republikan mengundi menyokong. Trump berkata beliau 'tidak tergesa-gesa' membuat keputusan mengenai Iran dan mungkin menunggu selepas tahun baharu.
summary.en: The non-binding resolution failed on 19 Nov, with Republicans Murkowski and Rand Paul voting yes. Trump said he is 'not rushing' to decide on Iran and may wait until after the new year.

title.bm: Senat AS tolak resolusi kuasa perang Iran 48-51
title.en: US Senate rejects Iran war powers resolution 48-51

why.bm: Menandakan dasar perang Washington tidak dihalang buat masa ini, justeru kebuntuan Hormuz berkemungkinan berterusan.
why.en: Signals Washington's war policy stays unconstrained for now, so the Hormuz standoff is likely to continue.

summary.bm: Laporan menyebut Merz menjadi tuan rumah 40 lebih negara di Berlin pada 19 Nov, dengan cadangan EUR45 bilion daripada EU dan GBP10 bilion daripada UK, manakala Britain berikrar 1,000 dron jarak jauh dalam pakej bantuan musim sejuk GBP260 juta. Putin menjemput Eropah ke Moscow tetapi menolak gencatan senjata.
summary.en: Reports say Merz hosted 40+ countries in Berlin on 19 Nov, with proposals of EUR45bn from the EU and GBP10bn from the UK, and Britain pledging 1,000 long-range drones within a GBP260m winter aid package. Putin invited Europeans to Moscow but ruled out a ceasefire.

title.bm: Sidang kemuncak 'gabungan sukarela' di Berlin sokong pembiayaan Ukraine; Putin tolak gencatan senjata
title.en: Berlin 'coalition of the willing' summit backs Ukraine funding; Putin rejects ceasefire

why.bm: Eropah meningkatkan pembiayaan sementara rundingan AS-Rusia tiada kejayaan; Majlis Eropah 26-27 Nov seterusnya.
why.en: Europe is stepping up funding as US-Russia talks yield no breakthrough; the 26-27 Nov European Council is next.

summary.bm: UKMTO merekodkan kira-kira satu serangan sehari bulan ini (sekitar 14 di Hormuz); ADNOC berkata sebuah kapalnya dihentam dengan seorang kelasi hilang dan 11 cedera, dan Kuwait memaklumkan IMO lapan kapal tangkinya diserang. Pesawat AS menyerang tapak peluru berpandu Iran di Pulau Qeshm minggu ini. UKMTO merekodkan kira-kira satu serangan sehari bulan ini (sekitar 14 insiden), dan lalu lintas minyak Hormuz jatuh kepada kira-kira 10 juta tong sehari menjelang 10 Nov daripada kira-kira 13.4 juta pada awal bulan, menurut Kpler.
summary.en: UKMTO has logged roughly one attack a day this month (about 14 in Hormuz); ADNOC said one of its ships was hit with one seafarer unaccounted for and 11 injured, and Kuwait told the IMO eight of its tankers were attacked. US warplanes struck an Iranian missile site on Qeshm Island this week. UKMTO counts roughly one attack a day this month (about 14 incidents), and Hormuz oil transits fell to about 10m barrels/day by Nov 10 from about 13.4m at the start of the month, per Kpler.

title.bm: Iran tingkatkan serangan kapal tangki di Hormuz; kapal ADNOC dihentam, kelasi hilang
title.en: Iran intensifies Hormuz tanker attacks; ADNOC ship hit, seafarers missing

why.bm: Risiko perkapalan dan insurans kekal tinggi walaupun Brent jatuh kira-kira satu perlima pada November.
why.en: Shipping and insurance risk stays high even as Brent has fallen about a fifth in November.

summary.bm: Kenyataan bersama ringkas (AP) merangkumi reformasi PBB, pengurangan risiko nuklear dan membawa lebih banyak bahan api ke pasaran, serta menyatakan pegawai negara patut kebal daripada pendakwaan ICC. Ia tidak menyebut Ukraine atau Iran, yang menurut Trump dibangkitkan dalam pertemuan dua hala; tiada perjanjian perdagangan dilaporkan.
summary.en: A short joint statement (AP) covered UN reforms, reducing nuclear risks and getting more fuel to market, and said state officials should have immunity from ICC prosecution. It did not mention Ukraine or Iran, which Trump says he raised in one-on-ones; no trade deal was reported.

title.bm: Trump, Xi dan Putin adakan pertemuan tiga hala pertama di Shenzhen: ikrar sederhana reformasi PBB dan pengurangan risiko nuklear, tiada kejayaan besar
title.en: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first trilateral in Shenzhen: modest UN-reform and nuclear-risk pledges, no breakthroughs

why.bm: Tiada perubahan konkrit pada perang Iran atau Ukraine, jadi risiko minyak dan sekatan kekal.
why.en: Little concrete change on the Iran war or Ukraine, so oil and sanctions risk remain unresolved.

summary.bm: Pegawai Pentagon memberitahu Kongres perang itu telah menelan lebih AS$48 bilion sejak akhir Februari. Iran enggan menerima kerjasama IAEA tanpa syarat ketika diserang, manakala Trump berkata serangan baharu 'agak mustahil' dan mungkin menunggu selepas 1 Jan.
summary.en: A Pentagon official told Congress the war has cost over $48bn since late February. Iran said it will not accept unconditional IAEA cooperation under attack, and Trump said new strikes are 'quite unlikely' and he may wait until after 1 Jan.

title.bm: Pentagon: Perang Iran telan lebih AS$48 bilion; Tehran tolak akses IAEA 'tanpa had' ketika dibom
title.en: Pentagon: Iran war has cost over $48bn; Tehran rejects 'unlimited' IAEA access while being bombed

why.bm: Mengisyaratkan kemungkinan jeda eskalasi AS tetapi risiko bekalan Hormuz kekal, menjejaskan harga bahan api.
why.en: Signals possible pause in US escalation but Hormuz supply risk stays, affecting fuel prices.

summary.bm: ANT mula didagangkan di Nasdaq pada 19 Nov selepas IPO rekod AS$81.3 bilion pada harga $83; CNN melaporkan penilaian kira-kira AS$1.76 trilion selepas hari pertama dan Fox News memetik lonjakan 34% melepasi harga IPO. Laporan sebelum ini menyebut tawaran dinaikkan kepada 980 juta saham dengan kutipan sekitar $79 bilion. Rumusan melaporkan IPO berharga AS$83 sesaham (simbol ANT), mengumpul kira-kira AS$81 bilion, dilaporkan IPO AS terbesar.
summary.en: ANT began trading on Nasdaq on Nov 19 after a record $81.3bn IPO priced at $83, and CNN reported a valuation of about $1.76 trillion after the first day, with Fox News citing a 34% jump above the IPO price. Earlier reports said the deal was upsized to 980 million shares, raising about $79bn. Roundups say the IPO priced at $83/share (ticker ANT), raising about $81bn, reportedly the largest US IPO on record.

title.bm: Anthropic melonjak 34% melepasi harga IPO pada hari pertama Nasdaq, bernilai kira-kira AS$1.76 trilion
title.en: Anthropic soars 34% above IPO price in Nasdaq debut, valued about $1.76 trillion

why.bm: Penyenaraian AI bersejarah yang mungkin menentukan nada penilaian AI; pergerakan hari pertama boleh berbalik.
why.en: A landmark AI listing that may set the tone for AI valuations; first-day moves can reverse.

summary.bm: Gemini 4 Neon berharga AS$3 sejuta token input dan AS$15 sejuta token output, menurut rumusan berita AI.
summary.en: Gemini 4 Neon is priced at $3 per million input and $15 per million output tokens, per AI news roundups.

title.bm: Google lancar Gemini 4 Neon dengan konteks 1 juta token
title.en: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon with 1M-token context

why.bm: Pilihan konteks panjang lebih murah untuk pembangun dan perniagaan.
why.en: Cheaper long-context option for developers and businesses.

summary.bm: Penguji awal mengkritik autonomi dan kebolehgunaan; OpenAI berkata model berubah banyak sebelum pelancaran.
summary.en: Early testers criticised autonomy and usability; OpenAI said the models changed substantially before launch.

title.bm: OpenAI keluarkan GPT-6.2 Astra dan Sol; penguji awal beri kritikan
title.en: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol; early testers critical

why.bm: Mempengaruhi persaingan antara pembantu AI teratas.
why.en: Shapes the competition among top AI assistants.

summary.bm: Gemini 4 Hydrogen tersedia dalam AI Studio, API Gemini, aplikasi Gemini dan Carian, berharga $1.50 sejuta token input dan $7.50 sejuta token output dengan konteks 1 juta token. Google mendakwa ia hampir setara Carbon pada Terminal-Bench 4.0 dengan penggunaan kuota 24% lebih rendah (angka syarikat).
summary.en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen is available in AI Studio, the Gemini API, the Gemini app and Search, priced at $1.50 per million input and $7.50 per million output tokens with a 1M-token context. Google says it nears Carbon on Terminal-Bench 4.0 with 24% less quota use (company figures).

title.bm: Google lancarkan Gemini 4 Hydrogen merentasi API, aplikasi dan Carian
title.en: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen across API, app and Search

why.bm: Peringkat Gemini yang lebih murah meningkatkan tekanan harga ke atas API AI pesaing.
why.en: A cheaper Gemini tier raises price pressure on rival AI APIs.

summary.bm: Pelancaran terhad kepada pengguna ChatGPT Pro AS berumur 18+ dengan kad AS; pembelian ditokenkan dan memerlukan kelulusan Face ID atau cap jari. Had perbelanjaan dirancang tetapi belum aktif.
summary.en: Rollout is limited to US ChatGPT Pro users aged 18+ with US cards; purchases are tokenised and need Face ID or fingerprint approval. Spending limits are planned but not yet live.

title.bm: ChatGPT Wallet dilancarkan supaya ejen AI boleh membeli-belah dan membayar
title.en: ChatGPT Wallet launches so AI agents can shop and check out

why.bm: Belum tersedia di Malaysia; tunggu had perbelanjaan.
why.en: Not available in Malaysia for now; wait for spending limits.

summary.bm: Fable 5.2 ialah model asas sama dengan Mythos 5.2 dengan perlindungan siber dan biologi lebih kuat, berharga $8/$40 per juta token ($16/$80 mod pantas). Anthropic masih menyifatkan Claude Opus 5.5 pilihan harian terbaik.
summary.en: Fable 5.2 is the same underlying model as Mythos 5.2 with stronger cyber and biology safeguards, priced at $8/$40 per million tokens ($16/$80 in fast mode). Anthropic still calls Claude Opus 5.5 its best daily driver.

title.bm: Anthropic lancar Claude Fable 5.2 untuk semua pengguna; Mythos 5.2 terhad kepada organisasi disahkan
title.en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 to all users; Mythos 5.2 limited to vetted orgs

why.bm: Semak kos dan had penggunaan sebelum bertukar model.
why.en: Check cost and usage limits before switching models.

summary.bm: Pintasan pengesahan dalam Directory Service vCenter memberi penyerang jauh sesi pentadbir; Broadcom membaiki pada 19 Nov (VMSA-2026-0009) tanpa penyelesaian sementara. Google GTIG dan Mandiant berkata kumpulan disyaki China, Armory Castle (dahulu UNC5221), mengeksploitasinya sejak awal September.
summary.en: An authentication bypass in vCenter's Directory Service gives remote attackers an admin session; Broadcom fixed it on 19 Nov (VMSA-2026-0009) with no workarounds. Google GTIG and Mandiant say suspected China-nexus group Armory Castle (formerly UNC5221) exploited it from early September.

title.bm: Kelemahan sifar-hari VMware vCenter (CVE-2026-123890, CVSS 9.8) dieksploitasi kumpulan dikaitkan China sejak September
title.en: VMware vCenter zero-day (CVE-2026-123890, CVSS 9.8) exploited by China-linked group since September

why.bm: Tampal segera: 9.1.1.0200, 9.0.2.0200 atau 8.0 U3m; hubungi Broadcom untuk 7.0. Asingkan pengurusan vCenter daripada internet.
why.en: Patch now: 9.1.1.0200, 9.0.2.0200 or 8.0 U3m; contact Broadcom for 7.0. Isolate vCenter management from the internet.

summary.bm: Perkhidmatan awan Mail Assure dan SpamExperts N-able terganggu beberapa hari sejak 16 Nov; pada 18 Nov syarikat mengesahkan serangan siber ke atas satu pelayan web yang mungkin mengakses bukti kelayakan tersimpan. Tiada bukti data pelanggan terjejas dan syarikat telah menukar kelayakan serta membatalkan token API.
summary.en: N-able's Mail Assure and SpamExperts cloud had a multi-day outage from 16 Nov; on 18 Nov it confirmed a cyberattack on one web server where stored credentials may have been accessed. It reports no evidence customer data was compromised and has rotated credentials and revoked API tokens.

title.bm: N-able sahkan penggodam mengakses pelayan awan Mail Assure
title.en: N-able confirms hackers accessed Mail Assure cloud server

why.bm: Jika anda mengurus keselamatan e-mel melalui N-able, pantau kemas kini vendor dan semak akses pentadbir.
why.en: If you manage email security via N-able, watch vendor updates and review admin access.

summary.bm: Seorang penyelidik menunjukkan pintasan berasaskan Narrator yang mencapai pemulihan akaun tanpa log masuk; ia memerlukan akaun dipautkan ke akaun Microsoft dan diuji pada Windows 11 26H2 dengan kemas kini November. Belum ada CVE, pembaikan atau serangan dilaporkan, dan ia tidak memecahkan penyulitan BitLocker.
summary.en: A researcher showed a Narrator-based bypass that reaches account recovery without signing in; it needs an account linked to a Microsoft account and was tested on Windows 11 26H2 with November updates. There is no CVE, fix or reported attack yet, and it does not break BitLocker encryption.

title.bm: Kelemahan 'FastUnlock' Windows 11 belum ditampal benarkan pelaku berakses fizikal jalankan kod dari skrin kunci
title.en: Unpatched Windows 11 'FastUnlock' flaw lets someone with physical access run code from the lock screen

why.bm: Risiko jauh rendah; pastikan komputer riba selamat secara fizikal dan pantau pembaikan Microsoft.
why.en: Low remote risk; keep laptops physically secure and watch for Microsoft's fix.

summary.bm: CISA menambah kelemahan deserialisasi itu ke KEV pada 17 Nov; ia menjejaskan Puppet Enterprise dan Puppet Core, serta OpenVox, dengan pembaikan dikeluarkan 3 Nov. Agensi AS mesti membaiki menjelang 1 Dis.
summary.en: CISA added the deserialization flaw to KEV on 17 Nov; it affects Puppet Enterprise and Puppet Core, plus OpenVox, with fixes released on 3 Nov. US agencies must remediate by 1 Dec.

title.bm: CISA tanda kelemahan RCE kritikal Puppet yang dieksploitasi aktif (CVE-2026-115731, CVSS 9.4)
title.en: CISA flags actively exploited critical Puppet RCE (CVE-2026-115731, CVSS 9.4)

why.bm: Kemas kini kepada PE 2026.0.1/2025.12.1/2023.8.13 atau Puppet Core 9.1.3/8.22.2; relevan untuk automasi rangkaian dan infrastruktur.
why.en: Patch to PE 2026.0.1/2025.12.1/2023.8.13 or Puppet Core 9.1.3/8.22.2; relevant to network and infrastructure automation.

summary.bm: Pepijat use-after-free dalam pengendalian XML Chrome sedang dieksploitasi. Ia dibaiki dalam 157.0.8103.50/.51 pada Windows dan macOS serta 157.0.8103.50 pada Linux.
summary.en: A use-after-free bug in Chrome's XML handling is being exploited in the wild. It is fixed in 157.0.8103.50/.51 on Windows and macOS and 157.0.8103.50 on Linux.

title.bm: Zero-day Chrome CVE-2026-125350 (CVSS 8.8) dieksploitasi; kemas kini ke 157.0.8103.50/.51
title.en: Chrome zero-day CVE-2026-125350 (CVSS 8.8) exploited; update to 157.0.8103.50/.51

why.bm: Kemas kini Chrome sekarang dan mulakan semula pelayar.
why.en: Update Chrome now and restart the browser.

summary.bm: Pepijat XXE tanpa pengesahan dalam penghurai XML OCI BroadWorks ditambah ke katalog KEV CISA pada 10 Nov; Cisco menampalnya pada Ogos. Malbear Labs melaporkan eksploitasi terhadap sebuah telko Eropah dan 13 organisasi, dengan tarikh akhir persekutuan 24 Nov.
summary.en: The unauthenticated XXE bug in BroadWorks' OCI XML parser was added to CISA's KEV catalog on Nov 10; Cisco patched it in August. Malbear Labs reports exploitation against a European telecom and 13 organisations, with a federal deadline of Nov 24.

title.bm: CISA tandakan kelemahan XXE Cisco BroadWorks yang dieksploit (CVE-2026-20320)
title.en: CISA flags exploited Cisco BroadWorks XXE flaw (CVE-2026-20320)

why.bm: Pasukan rangkaian/telekom yang menggunakan BroadWorks: pastikan tampalan Cisco Ogos telah dipasang sekarang.
why.en: Network/telecom teams running BroadWorks: confirm the August Cisco fix is applied now.

summary.bm: Cult of Mac melaporkan Full Disk Access dipecahkan kepada Accessibility dan System & App Protection Override, dengan pilihan 'Ask First' atau 'At Any Time' bagi setiap aplikasi serta penunjuk bar menu. Perubahan hanya untuk permintaan kebenaran baharu dan masih beta.
summary.en: Cult of Mac reports Full Disk Access is split into Accessibility and System & App Protection Override, with per-app 'Ask First' or 'At Any Time' choices and a menu bar indicator. Changes apply to new permission requests only and it is still beta.

title.bm: macOS 27.3 beta 2 beri kawalan lebih terperinci terhadap akses ejen AI
title.en: macOS 27.3 beta 2 gives users finer control over what AI agents can access

why.bm: Membantu menghadkan apa yang ejen AI pada Mac boleh lakukan bagi pihak anda.
why.en: Helps limit what AI agents on a Mac can do on your behalf.

summary.bm: Notifikasi ancaman Apple 29 Okt dihantar kepada pengguna di 99 negara; menteri Thailand berkata amaran sahaja tidak membuktikan peranti dijejaskan dan tiada bukti kaitan dengan Pegasus. SecurityWeek turut menerangkan bagaimana Secure Exclaves Apple melindungi data kamera dan mikrofon.
summary.en: Apple's 29 Oct threat notifications went to users in 99 countries; Thailand's minister said alerts alone do not show a device was compromised and no evidence links it to Pegasus. SecurityWeek separately explained how Apple's Secure Exclaves protect camera and microphone data.

title.bm: Apple bertemu pegawai Thailand berhubung amaran perisian intip selepas notifikasi ancaman 29 Okt
title.en: Apple meets Thai officials over spyware alerts sent after its 29 Oct threat notifications

why.bm: Jika menerima amaran ancaman Apple, kemas kini iOS dan pertimbangkan Mod Lockdown.
why.en: If you receive an Apple threat alert, update iOS and consider Lockdown Mode.

summary.bm: Nasihat menyenaraikan kira-kira sembilan kelemahan dalam sembang kumpulan iMessage, pasangan Bluetooth dan AirPlay; Apple tidak menyatakan ada yang dieksploitasi.
summary.en: The advisory lists around nine vulnerabilities in iMessage group chat, Bluetooth pairing and AirPlay; Apple did not say any was exploited.

title.bm: Apple keluarkan pembaikan keselamatan iOS/macOS 27.2.1, serta iOS 26.7.3 dan 18.7.12 untuk peranti lama
title.en: Apple ships iOS/macOS 27.2.1 security fixes, plus iOS 26.7.3 and 18.7.12 for older devices

why.bm: Kemas kini melalui Settings > General > Software Update.
why.en: Update via Settings > General > Software Update.

summary.bm: Bermula iOS, iPadOS, macOS dan visionOS 27.3, fail dan foto yang dikongsi dengan 'sesiapa yang ada pautan' boleh diakses Apple untuk semakan, walaupun Advanced Data Protection dihidupkan. Pautan yang dikongsi hanya dengan individu tertentu dikecualikan, dan Apple boleh membuang kandungan atau melumpuhkan akaun, dengan keluaran awam dijangka pada Disember.
summary.en: From iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS 27.3, files and photos shared with 'Anyone with the link' become accessible to Apple for review, even with Advanced Data Protection on. Links shared only with named people are excluded, and Apple may remove content or disable accounts, with public release expected in December.

title.bm: Apple akan semak pautan iCloud awam untuk kandungan berbahaya mulai iOS 27.3, menamatkan penyulitan hujung ke hujung bagi pautan itu
title.en: Apple will review public iCloud links for harmful content from iOS 27.3, ending end-to-end encryption for them

why.bm: Jika anda berkongsi pautan iCloud secara awam, anggap ia tidak peribadi; kongsi dengan individu tertentu sebaliknya.
why.en: If you share iCloud links publicly, treat them as non-private; share with named people instead.

summary.bm: Android Police berkata sesetengah pengguna Pixel 11 Pro dan Pro XL melihat skrin hitam atau ralat pada aplikasi kamera, berdasarkan hantaran pengguna dan bukan kerosakan meluas yang disahkan. Google belum mengeluarkan pembaikan rasmi; mematikan telefon 1–2 minit membantu sekurang-kurangnya seorang pengguna.
summary.en: Android Police says some Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL users see a black screen or error in the camera app, based on user posts rather than a confirmed widespread fault. Google has not issued an official fix; powering off for 1–2 minutes helped at least one user.

title.bm: Pemilik Pixel lapor pepijat kamera dan lain-lain selepas kemas kini Android 17 November
title.en: Pixel owners report camera and other bugs after the Android 17 November update

why.bm: Jika terjejas, mulakan semula dan tunggu pembaikan Google.
why.en: If affected, restart and watch for Google's fix before rolling back.

summary.bm: Skrin belakang menyokong apl Google, Spotify dan apl GenAI buatan pengguna, menurut 9to5Google.
summary.en: The rear displays support Google apps, Spotify and user-built GenAI apps, according to 9to5Google.

title.bm: Skrin belakang Xiaomi 18 Pro dan Pro Max boleh jalankan Google Maps, YouTube Music, Spotify dan apl GenAI tersuai
title.en: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Pro Max rear displays can run Google Maps, YouTube Music, Spotify and custom GenAI apps

why.bm: Menunjukkan usaha Xiaomi menjadikan skrin kedua berguna pada model global.
why.en: Shows Xiaomi's push to make secondary screens useful on global models.

summary.bm: Tajuk berita menyebut ia membaiki hampir 180 kelemahan (tajuk sahaja; halaman tidak dibuka).
summary.en: Headlines say it fixes almost 180 vulnerabilities (headline only; page not opened).

title.en: Samsung rolls out November security patch to Galaxy S26 and Z Fold 8

why.bm: Pasang kemas kini pada telefon Galaxy anda.
why.en: Install the update on your Galaxy phone.

summary.bm: Ia meliputi Pixel 6a hingga Pixel 11 Pro Fold dengan 33 pembaikan Pixel; tahap tampalan 2026-11-01 dan 2026-11-05 disertakan.
summary.en: It covers Pixel 6a through Pixel 11 Pro Fold with 33 Pixel fixes; patch levels 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-05 are included.

title.en: Android 17 QPR2 ships early with November Pixel Feature Drop and security patch

why.en: Update via Settings > System > System update.

summary.bm: Nvidia berhenti menghantar cip kelas H200 ke China walaupun diluluskan AS; CEO sementara Colette Kress berkata tiada penghantaran berlesen lagi dirancang. Moody's menurunkan tinjauan kepada stabil kerana tiada pelan penggantian.
summary.en: Nvidia stopped shipping H200-class chips to China despite US approval, with interim CEO Colette Kress saying no further licensed shipments are planned. Moody's cut its outlook to stable citing no succession plan.

title.bm: Nvidia henti penghantaran H200 ke China; Jensen Huang telah keluar; Moody's turunkan tinjauan
title.en: Nvidia halts China H200 shipments; Jensen Huang has left; Moody's cuts outlook

why.bm: Gegaran bagi rantaian bekalan cip AI, termasuk pusat data Malaysia.
why.en: A shake-up for the AI chip supply chain, including Malaysian data centres.

summary.bm: Hasil naik 103% tahun ke tahun, dengan hasil pusat data $107.6 bilion dan tambahan belian semula saham $150 bilion; panduan suku keempat tidak mengambil kira jualan pengiraan pusat data ke China. Saham Nvidia dilaporkan jatuh kira-kira 28% sebulan, dan lembaga tidak berhasrat mengembalikan Jensen Huang sebagai CEO.
summary.en: Revenue rose 103% year on year, with data centre revenue of $107.6bn and a $150bn buyback increase; Q4 guidance assumes no China data-centre compute sales. Nvidia stock is reported down about 28% in a month, and the board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.

title.bm: Nvidia catat hasil suku ketiga sekitar $115.8 bilion, unjur suku keempat sekitar $130 bilion, Kress CEO sementara
title.en: Nvidia posts Q3 revenue of about $115.8bn, guides Q4 to about $130bn, with Kress as interim CEO

why.bm: Menentukan nada permintaan cip AI yang mempengaruhi pusat data dan sektor semikonduktor Malaysia.
why.en: Sets the tone for AI-chip demand that drives Malaysian data-centre and semiconductor plans.

summary.bm: The Star melaporkan Washington bertindak menyekat akses jauh kepada cip AI termaju melalui negara ketiga. Nvidia juga menolak kepulangan Jensen Huang ketika kempen menuntut beliau kembali membesar, menjelang laporan pendapatan.
summary.en: The Star reports Washington is moving to restrict remote access to advanced AI chips through third countries. Nvidia also ruled out a comeback by Jensen Huang as a campaign for his return grows, ahead of its earnings.

title.bm: AS bertindak menyekat akses jauh kepada cip AI termaju melalui negara ketiga
title.en: US moves to restrict remote access to advanced AI chips via third countries

why.bm: Boleh menjejaskan akses awan dan pusat data untuk beban kerja AI yang dihoskan di Malaysia.
why.en: Could affect cloud and data centre access for Malaysia-hosted AI workloads.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan projek kabel dasar laut bernilai RM2.7 bilion itu diluluskan. Ia akan menghubungkan Semenanjung Malaysia dengan Sabah dan Sarawak.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports the RM2.7 billion submarine cable project has been approved. It would link Peninsular Malaysia with Sabah and Sarawak.

why.en: Better connectivity for East Malaysia and for data-centre and digital growth.
